# This is Suricata version 8.0.8 RELEASE, run by make-http-verdicts.py; do not edit by hand.
# 'rule SID RULE', or 'refused SID RULE' when Suricata does not load it,
# then 'packet NS HEX SIDS': the packet's time in nanoseconds, its IP
# bytes and the sids that alerted on it, a sid once per alert, '-' for none,
# then 'end N SIDS': what alerted when flow N was flushed at the end of
# the capture, its last address byte being N, then 'proto N NAME': the
# application protocol Suricata logged for flow N.
rule 8000 alert http any any -> any any (msg:"http 8000"; flow:to_server; http.method; content:"GET";)
rule 8001 alert http any any -> any any (msg:"http 8001"; http.uri; content:"/index.html"; endswith;)
rule 8002 alert http any any -> any any (msg:"http 8002"; http.uri.raw; content:"%2e%2e";)
rule 8003 alert http any any -> any any (msg:"http 8003"; http.uri; content:"/a/b?"; startswith;)
rule 8004 alert http any any -> any any (msg:"http 8004"; http.uri; content:"?q=a b";)
rule 8005 alert http any any -> any any (msg:"http 8005"; http.uri; content:"?q=a+b";)
rule 8006 alert http any any -> any any (msg:"http 8006"; http.uri; content:"&r= x#f";)
rule 8007 alert http any any -> any any (msg:"http 8007"; http.host; content:"example.com"; startswith; endswith;)
rule 8008 alert http any any -> any any (msg:"http 8008"; http.host.raw; content:"Example.COM"; startswith; endswith;)
rule 8009 alert http any any -> any any (msg:"http 8009"; http.user_agent; content:"curl/8"; startswith; endswith;)
rule 8010 alert http any any -> any any (msg:"http 8010"; http.header; content:"X-Test: 1|0d 0a|";)
rule 8011 alert http any any -> any any (msg:"http 8011"; http.header; content:"Cookie";)
rule 8012 alert http any any -> any any (msg:"http 8012"; http.cookie; content:"sess=1"; startswith; endswith;)
rule 8013 alert http any any -> any any (msg:"http 8013"; http.request_line; content:"GET /index.html HTTP/1.1"; startswith; endswith;)
rule 8014 alert http any any -> any any (msg:"http 8014"; http.stat_code; content:"200"; startswith; endswith;)
rule 8015 alert http any any -> any any (msg:"http 8015"; http.stat_msg; content:"Not Found"; startswith; endswith;)
rule 8016 alert http any any -> any any (msg:"http 8016"; http.response_line; content:"HTTP/1.1 404 Not Found|0d 0a|"; startswith; endswith;)
rule 8017 alert http any any -> any any (msg:"http 8017"; http.server; content:"nginx"; startswith; endswith;)
rule 8018 alert http any any -> any any (msg:"http 8018"; http.response_body; content:"secret"; startswith; endswith;)
rule 8019 alert http any any -> any any (msg:"http 8019"; file.data; content:"secret"; startswith; endswith;)

rule 8024 alert http any any -> any any (msg:"http 8024"; http.start; content:"200 OK|0d 0a 0d 0a|Server"; )
rule 8025 alert http any any -> any any (msg:"http 8025"; http.protocol; content:"HTTP/1.1"; startswith; endswith;)

rule 8038 alert http any any -> any any (msg:"http 8038"; http.location; content:"/next"; startswith; endswith;)
